notes.title: Coral Drive - English Support!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41976602/c93a1e1bab7319f520bf0ea690b7aac5e839efe2.png[/img]

[h1][b]English Support[/b][/h1]

Coral Drive now supports the English version!
In addition, various bugs that were reported have been additionally fixed.
Check out the details below!

[h3]1. Support for new language[/h3]
[list]
[*]Coral drives now support English.
[*]If you are already in progress, you can make changes in the Settings window.
[*]If you're starting a new game, select language on Library > Title right click > Properties > Language and you can start the game right away with selected language.
[/list]
[h3]2. Bug fix[/h3]
[list]
[*]Bug with different overall size and number of parts required by ship with repair tag.
[*]Bug that freezes the screen or duplicates background music during a conversation.
[*]Bug that obtains duplicate exploration rewards.
[/list]
[h3]3. Additional issues[/h3]
[list]
[*]Some tutorials in the game have been improved.
[*]You can find help in the upper right corner of the title screen.
[/list]

Thanks to your information, we were able to fix the bug quickly!
Please keep sending us more information!

Thank you.

notes.title: Update for April 29
notes.content:
A new version update has been made.
The following is what was added through this update.

Update Details
 - New language support has been added. Now you can enjoy the game in English.
 - Fixed a bug where the number of parts required by the ship with the repair tag did not match the overall size.
 - Fixed a bug where the screen stopped or the background music overlapped during the game.
 - Fixed a bug to obtain duplicate exploration rewards.
 - Some tutorials have been improved.
 - Help is available in the upper right corner of the title screen.

Thanks to your information, we were able to fix the bug quickly.
Please keep sending us lots of information.

Thank you.
